summary: You can still include Dublin Core in your site and play with #IndieWeb, many people include LinkedData as well, but most of all our tools rely on a tiny bit of metadata in the HTML called microformats. They can all play nice together but you have to repeat yourself.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: You can still include Dublin Core in your site and play with #IndieWeb, many people include LinkedData as well, but most of all our tools rely on a tiny bit of metadata in the HTML called microformats. They can all play nice together but you have to repeat yourself.
